messages:
sam_support: FYI acme-corp reported SSO failures right after their IdP cert rotation (~2025-11-12T09:12Z). They see 403 on login and our logs show TLS handshake failures + signature verification errors. Repro steps attached.

sam_support: repro (from customer):
```
1) User hits /login -> redirects to IdP
2) IdP POSTs to ACS https://app.acme-corp.com:8443/saml/consume
3) Our edge logs show: 
ALB: TLS alert: handshake_failure (protocol version)
redwood-auth: saml: signature verification failed: SignatureMethod uses sha1
curl: (35) error:1400410B:SSL routines: unsupported protocol
```

maria_eng_platform: Can you paste the IdP metadata URL and the ACS in their SP config?

sam_support: metadata url: https://idp.acme-corp.com/metadata.xml
Their SP ACS in our UI is set to https://app.acme-corp.com/saml/consume (no port). Their metadata has ACS with explicit port 8443: 
```xml
<AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://app.acme-corp.com:8443/saml/consume" index="0"/>
<!-- Signature uses SHA1 -->
<Signature>
  <SignedInfo>
    <SignatureMethod Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#rsa-sha1"/>
  </SignedInfo>
</Signature>
```

liam_security: Two separate issues here: 1) Their metadata signature uses SHA-1 which our verifier rejects by policy (we disabled SHA1 metadata signing 2025-10-01). 2) Their IdP endpoint only negotiates TLS <=1.0 (per ALB error). Our frontends require TLS1.2+. That TLS downgrade is causing the handshake_failure before SAML processing.

liam_security: We can't accept SHA1-signed metadata or talk down to TLS1.0 on prod for security/compliance reasons. Customer needs to reissue IdP cert using sha256 and enable TLS1.2+.

sam_support: Customer says they rotated certs themselves and the IdP vendor defaulted to older TLS cipher suite and a SHA1 signing config. They can't change vendor config until support ticket w/ vendor is processed (24-48h). Need short-term mitigation.

maria_eng_platform: Possible temporary workarounds: 
- Manual metadata upload in Console (we allow manual metadata) after verifying chain. This avoids live metadata fetch over TLS.
- Temporary metadata proxy that fetches from IdP using relaxed TLS and re-publishes into our metadata cache after validating cert chain and converting signature alg (we don't rewrite signatures; only reserve metadata as-is when manually uploaded).

rohit_oncall: I can do a manual metadata upload for them if they provide the raw metadata XML and proof of control. If they want the proxy approach I'll spin up a short-lived fetcher in our staging VPC that allows TLS1.0 for outbound to idp.acme-corp.com and then push into our metadata service. Need AM approvals for proxy.

elaine_cust_success: Customer confirms they can provide metadata XML + org proof. They'll request vendor change but want immediate login fixes for ~100 users.

rohit_oncall: Performed manual metadata upload at 2025-11-12T10:08Z into metadata cache (checked chain, thumbprints). I normalized ACS to the SP-configured URL (kept note that their metadata uses port 8443 which differs from configured ACS). Also added a temporary note in their tenant: "manual-metadata-temp-20251112".

deploy_bot: metadata-cache: manual upload accepted for tenant acme-corp by rohit_oncall. Cache TTL set to 6h pending vendor fix.

maria_eng_platform: After manual upload auth flows started succeeding for a subset of users. We need customer to: 1) reissue IdP metadata signed with SHA256, 2) enable TLS1.2+ on IdP endpoints, 3) ensure ACS in metadata exactly matches SP config (including port and trailing slash).

liam_security: Postmortem note: we must document this pattern (vendor defaulting to SHA1 + TLS1.0). Add a KB entry: "IdP vendor-side legacy TLS/SHA1 rotation -> manual metadata upload mitigation".

sam_support: Closing loop with customer: they will escalate to vendor and share timeline. Temp mitigation applied. Will reopen if errors reappear after vendor rotation. :thumbsup:

ACTION ITEMS:
- customer: reissue cert w/ SHA256 + enable TLS1.2+ (Owner: acme-corp, ETA 48h)
- support: confirm ACS URL exactly matches after vendor rotation (Owner: sam_support)
- eng-platform: add KB + one-click manual-metadata flow docs (Owner: maria_eng_platform)
- security: record policy exceptions and automated detection for SHA1-signed metadata (Owner: liam_security)
